tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ bhu mi sū tra/ bod skad du/ sa'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das sum bcu rtsa gsum na/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas/ shing yongs 'dus brtol gyi rtsa ba na bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ skye bo gang zhig bde 'gror mchis// skye bo gang zhig mtho ris skye// gang zhig nyin dang mtshan rnams su// rtag tu bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur// lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis de skad ces tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis zhus pa'i lan gsungs pa/ kun dga' ra ba nags tshal skyed// skye bo gang zhig zam pa byed// chu steng khang dang chu mig dang*// gang zhig ngal gso gnas ster dang*// dad dang tshul khrims phun tshogs ldan// mkhas shing ser sna dang bral zhing*// 'dod pa kun la ma chags na// rtag tu sems can phan brtson pa'i// skye bo de ni bde 'gror 'gro// skye bo de ni mtho ris skye// de ni nyin dang mtshan rnams su// rtag tu bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur// ser sna dang ldan lhar mi 'gro// byis des sbyin pa ster mi byed// brtan rnams sbyin pa yid rangs pa// des 'di gzhan du bde bar 'gyur// zhing gi skyon ni tswa yin ltar// skyes bu 'di la 'dod chags skyon// de bas chags dang bral rnams la// byin dang 'bras bu chen por 'gyur// gang zhig sangs rgyas chos rnams dang*// dge 'dun dag dang mchod rten dang*// skyes pa'am yang na bud med dag /tshul khrims ldan pa'i mi la byin// gang dang gang du skye 'gyur ba// ji ltar mi yi rgyal po bzhin// lha rnams kyi ni mchog 'gyur zhing*// lhag pa'i rgyal po byed pa 'gyur// 'khor bar yongs su 'khor ba na// sbyin pa ma gtogs gnyen med par// blo ldan phun tshogs 'dod pa yis// rab tu 'bad de sbyin pa byin// gang zhig mda' rgyang gang tsam zhig

/sa 'di sbyin pa rab gtong ba// de ni lha yi gnas song nas// mtho ris dag tu bskal bar dga'// gang zhig kun dga' ra ba tsam// sa ni sbyin par gtong byed pa// tshangs pa'i mdun na rab bskyed de// mtho ris dag tu bskal bar dga'// brgya byin gtsug lag khang gi phyir// sa ni sbyin par gtong byed pa// tshangs pa'i bsod nams rab skyed de// mtho ris dag tu bskal bar dga'// sa ni 'khru ba'i 'phreng bcas sa// rmos pa mtshan mar bcas byin na// bskal pa bye ba stong phrag tu// de ni skye ba nyams mi 'gyur/ tshul khrims ldan la khyad par du// 'bras bu'i zhing ni gang gis byin// gang gis byin pa de yis ni// 'bras bu mi zad de 'thob 'gyur// sa ni sa lu bu ram shing*/ nas ni ljang pas brgyan pa dag /gang zhig sbyin par byed pa de// lha mchog bde ba rab 'phel 'gyur// ral gri seng ge gdan dang gdugs// rta mchog glang po mchog rnams dang*// sa sbyin pa yi me tog ste// brgya byin 'bras bu thar pa yin// gang zhig sa ni len pa dang*// gang zhig sa ni ster byed pa// gnyis ka phan byed yin pa'i phyir// nges par mtho ris dag tu 'gro// brgya byin ji ltar chu la ni// til mar thigs pas khyab byed pa// de bzhin sa ni sbyin pa la// yang dag brten las bsod nams 'phel// ji ltar 'o ma yod pa'i ba// 'o ma 'byin pas be'u gso// bskal bzang de bzhin sa gtong ba// sa yis yongs su gsos par 'gyur// de bzhin sa rab sbyin pa yis// zho dang mar gsar chu bo dang*// 'o ma'i chu ni 'bab pa yis// tshim par byed pa nyid du 'gyur// rgyal po 'dod chags kyis gdungs nas// sdig pa gang zhig byas gyur pa// dor phyed tsam zhig gnod gyur la/ byin pas bde 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur// rgyal po 'dod chags kyis gdungs te// sdig pa gang zhig byas gyur pa// dor phyed tsam zhig dge 'dun la// byin pas bde 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur// tswa las sa ni yongs su brtag

/ma yi phyogs las be'u brtags te// rta ni pha yi phyogs las brtag /tshul khrims 'tsho bas mi rnams so// bsam gtan sa rab sbyin pa las// gang zhig zlog par byed pa dang*// de dag bsdus 'joms ri bo ni// dmyal bar mi ni 'gro bar 'gyur// sa dang mnyam pa'i sbyin pa byed// sbyin dang mnyam pa'i gter mang la// bden dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams med// rdzun pas gzhan pa'i sdig pa med// de nas brgya byin stobs ldan pa'i// bde sogs bdag pos lus btud de// rin chen rang bzhin sa bya bas// dkon mchog gsum la kun tu mchod// sa'i mdo rdzogs so/// /rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad+ma ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/// /
